# SARVA AI

> SARVA AI is a full-stack open-source AI chatbot platform built with React 19, FastAPI (Python), MongoDB Atlas, and Groq LPU hardware acceleration. It provides multi-turn conversational AI, PDF document analysis, persistent chat memory, and enterprise team workspace management with role-based access control.

## Project Information

- **Author**: Karan Garg
- **License**: MIT
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Drakowarrior/sarva-ai
- **Live Platform**: https://sarva-ai-one.vercel.app/
- **Last Updated**: 2026-09-12

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React 19, Vite, React Router, Framer Motion, Vanilla CSS
- **Backend**: FastAPI (Python 3.11+), Uvicorn, Motor (async MongoDB driver)
- **Database**: MongoDB Atlas (cloud-hosted, Motor async driver)
- **AI Inference**: Groq Cloud API (Llama 3.3 70B, hardware LPU acceleration, 300+ tokens/sec)
- **Document Processing**: pypdf, python-docx, Pillow (PDF, DOCX, image text extraction)
- **Security**: JWT bearer token authentication, bcrypt password hashing, RBAC, CORS origin restriction
- **Deployment**: Vercel (frontend), Render (backend), MongoDB Atlas (database)

## Engineering Blog & Technical Guides

- [Blog Hub](https://sarva-ai-one.vercel.app/blog): Technical articles, architecture breakdowns, and implementation guides for AI developers.
- [Build AI Chatbot with React & FastAPI](https://sarva-ai-one.vercel.app/blog/react-fastapi-ai-chatbot): Step-by-step guide to integrating React 19 with FastAPI, SSE streaming, and MongoDB session persistence.
- [Fast AI Chatbot with Groq & LLaMA](https://sarva-ai-one.vercel.app/blog/fastapi-groq-chatbot): Hardware-accelerated inference with Groq LPUs and Llama 3.3 70B streaming at 300+ tokens/sec.
- [Chat With PDF Documents](https://sarva-ai-one.vercel.app/blog/chat-with-pdf): Complete guide to PDF text extraction, context injection, chunking strategies, limitations, and FastAPI implementation.
- [AI Document Analysis Pipeline](https://sarva-ai-one.vercel.app/blog/ai-document-analysis): Multi-format document text extraction, MIME validation, FastAPI pipeline, and LLM summarization.
- [Full-Stack AI Architecture Guide](https://sarva-ai-one.vercel.app/blog/full-stack-ai-architecture): Production deployment guide for React on Vercel Edge, FastAPI on Render, and MongoDB Atlas.
- [JWT Authentication for AI Chatbots](https://sarva-ai-one.vercel.app/blog/jwt-ai-chatbot): JWT bearer token security, bcrypt encryption, multi-tenant session isolation, and RBAC enforcement.
- [Conversational AI Memory & History](https://sarva-ai-one.vercel.app/blog/chat-history-memory): MongoDB Atlas schema design and Motor async queries for persistent multi-turn session memory.

## Public API Reference

- **Health Check**: GET https://sarva-ai.onrender.com/api/health (public)
- **API Documentation**: https://sarva-ai.onrender.com/docs (Swagger UI, public)
- All other endpoints require JWT bearer token authentication.
